retry_policy: No retry, repair, version/profile/source/flags sweep after launch; preserve any setup/compile/strip/post-analysis failure and stop.
helper_root_layout: copy exact helpers/scripts/* to <experiment>/repo/scripts; source/ tree to <experiment>/repo retaining paths
strip_role: v1.52 SDK strip phase, exact existing pinned stripper

private_cache.copy_mode: fresh regular byte copies only; no hardlinks or shared mutable cache
private_cache.permitted_material: Only252 lock-approved crate versions, their archive-authenticated extracted files/cargo markers, sparse index metadata for the same approved names and public dl/api index config
private_cache.global_credentials_config_token_files: Never copied, read, inherited or required

minimal_environment.HOME: inherit unchanged real user home only; never repoint HOME

private_rustup: Seed private outer toolchain symlinks/settings from existing host default without modifying global aliases; unchanged helper creates private output rustup and CLI solana alias there.
sourcepath_safety: Fresh experiment outside checkout/proposal; reject symlink/.. paths; no .cargo config/toolchain selector in source or invocation ancestors. Exact source scanner must equal proposed37 before and after.

actual_exit_status_policy.helper_build_sbf_aggregate: Record actual unchanged helper and build-sbf returncodes/logs; no fabricated inner compiler/strip child status
actual_exit_status_policy.optional_strip_rule: Only if reviewed launcher owns this separate invocation: retain its actual exit/log and require byte equality with driver artifact. Label it separate validation, not observed original driver-child status.

post_analysis.backend_diagnostics: Always retain raw logs and anchored ANSI-stripped Error: lines plus prior stack/LLVM patterns; aggregate0 is not readiness.
post_analysis.full_ledger: Copy frozen analysis methods byte-identically, use original capture only after build and existing selected e949/04641 as BEFORE; new candidate/symbols as AFTER. Exhaust original/candidate functions, raw/normalized+relocations, actual call closure, data/section/whole-file mismatches and negatives.
post_analysis.ctor_guards: Review full emitted parser/wrapper/application and ordered6019 zero/holderPDA/sharingkey guard +6091 fee/default/WSOL/single-whitelist predicate, named owned constructor/common returns, and unchanged6092 routes. Do not assume offsets, counts, exact LLVM shape or diagnostic identity.

captured_executable_role: Comparison-only after compiler/strip; never inserted into Rust/helper/dependency source or compiler command inputs.
